description: This file defines a Java class 'VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter' that implements a Vert.x based AMQP protocol adapter for the Eclipse Hono project. It manages AMQP server setup, connection handling, authentication, message processing (telemetry, events, commands), and link management, facilitating communication between devices and Hono's backend via AMQP.

classes.name: VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A Vert.x based implementation of a protocol adapter for AMQP communication within Eclipse Hono, handling server setup, device connections, message processing, and link management.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name of the protocol adapter, 'amqp'.

methods.name: setMetrics
methods.description: Injects the metrics implementation used for collecting metrics.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves the current metrics implementation.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes server bindings and authentication setup to start the adapter.

methods.name: createConnectionLimitManager
methods.description: Creates a default connection limit manager based on available memory.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the AMQP servers.

methods.name: stopInsecureServer
methods.description: Stops the insecure AMQP server if running.

methods.name: stopSecureServer
methods.description: Stops the secure AMQP server if running.

methods.name: bindInsecureServer
methods.description: Binds and starts the insecure AMQP server if configured.

methods.name: bindSecureServer
methods.description: Binds and starts the secure AMQP server with TLS if configured.

methods.name: createServer
methods.description: Creates a new ProtonServer instance with optional TLS and authentication options.

methods.name: onConnectRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming connection requests, managing sessions, links, and device authentication.

methods.name: processRemoteOpen
methods.description: Processes a remote connection open, performs authentication and resource setup, and establishes the connection context.

methods.name: validateEndpoint
methods.description: Validates that an incoming message is targeted at supported endpoints such as telemetry, event, command, or command response.

methods.name: uploadMessage
methods.description: Handles forwarding a received message to downstream consumers based on its endpoint type.

methods.name: doUploadMessage
methods.description: Executes the forwarding of telemetry or event messages to the designated downstream sender.

methods.name: doUploadCommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Processes and forwards a command response message from a device.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Processes an incoming device message, determining acceptance, rejection, or release based on processing and validation.

methods.name: handleRemoteReceiverOpen
methods.description: Handles the opening of a remote receiver link for device message uploads, performs validation, and sets up message handlers.

methods.name: handleRemoteSenderOpenForCommands
methods.description: Handles the remote sender link for command delivery to devices, validating source addresses and opening command consumers.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a command consumer link for sending commands to devices and manages command dispatching.

methods.name: onCommandReceived
methods.description: Handles the receipt of a command from an application and sends it to the device, managing dispositions.

methods.name: closeLinkWithError
methods.description: Closes an AMQP link with an error condition derived from a throwable.

methods.name: uploadMessage
methods.description: Forwards a received device message through the downstream sender, handling content validation and metrics.

methods.name: getResourceIdentifier
methods.description: Parses and retrieves resource identification from an AMQP source address.

methods.name: applyTenantTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Derives and applies trace sampling priority based on tenant configuration, propagating in contexts or spans.
